title: Build order after milestone 1
ask: Milestone 1 is the agent system without the console (your decision). What comes next?
why: Order of delivery. Milestone 1 is decided: the agent system without the console.
rec_reason: A read-only console makes the TOML state visible quickly, and verbs already work from the CLI, so nothing blocks on a writable UI.

options.label: Read-only console: dashboard, board, generated ticket pages
options.desc: Makes the TOML state visible; verbs already work from the CLI.
pros: See tickets, decisions and pages early
cons: You edit through CLI and agents for a while

options.label: Onboarding scaffold: generate the knowledge repo
options.desc: Could even move into milestone 1 so the agent system has a home.
pros: The agent system gets its home from day one
options.pick_if: you want a clean start for new workspaces.

options.label: Assistant and Telegram
options.desc: Capture anywhere, then the delivery pipeline.

options.label: Writable console first: tickets, todos, settings
options.desc: Everything editable in the UI early.
cons: Needs the verbs and validator first
options.pick_if: you will operate mostly from the UI.

title: Front-end spike before the console milestone
ask: Before building the console, do we run a small spike to confirm the React and Tailwind choice?
why: Both independent reviews flagged agent code quality, state handling and bundle size as unverified. Half a day of evidence is cheaper than a wrong stack.
rec_reason: Build one slice in React: board, ticket, sandboxed plan page and back, with light and dark. Count agent tokens and retries for two later changes, check keyboard use and a 400 px width. Build the Svelte 5 slice only if the React run shows trouble.

options.label: React first: board, ticket, sandboxed plan page, back, light and dark; two later changes by an agent; Svelte 5 only if React shows trouble
pros: Gives evidence on tokens, retries and state bugs
cons: Does not compare against Svelte unless needed
options.pick_if: you accept React unless proven wrong.

options.label: Build the same slice in React and in Svelte 5 and compare
Skip the spike and build
cons: Unverified assumptions about agent quality and widgets
